title: Email Bundle Credit on Certificate Installation
content:
## Email bundle credit: managed installations of SSL/TLS Certificates

A managed installation of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries a fixed mail bundle credit against the managed installation charge. The credit depends on how the customer's email runs for the certificate's registered domain under Professional Email. A Professional Email subscription counts when it carries the same linked Harborline domain as the certificate subscription and its status is active.

| Professional Email on the certificate's domain | Mail bundle credit on the managed installation |
|---|---|
| an active Harborline Mail subscription (Harborline Mail Starter, Harborline Mail Plus or Harborline Mail Pro) | USD 3.00 |
| no active Harborline Mail subscription, but an active Microsoft 365 subscription (Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Microsoft 365 Business Standard or Microsoft 365 Business Premium) | USD 1.50 |
| neither | no mail bundle credit |

**Combinations**

- Harborline Mail active and Microsoft 365 also active on the same domain: USD 3.00. The Harborline Mail row decides, and the two credits are never both given.
- Microsoft 365 active and no active Harborline Mail: USD 1.50.
- An email subscription on the domain whose status is anything other than active does not count.
- An active email subscription on a different domain of the same customer does not count.

The credit is one fixed amount per managed installation.
